headline: OpenAI to acquire Ona, expanding Codex with secure cloud environments for AI agents.

items.title: OpenAI to acquire Ona
items.summary: OpenAI plans to acquire Ona to enhance Codex by integrating secure, persistent cloud environments. This acquisition aims to facilitate long-running AI agents across enterprise workflows, significantly improving the robustness and scalability of AI-powered solutions.
items.why_it_matters: This move will allow tech leads to implement more reliable and secure AI agents in enterprise systems, enhancing operational efficiency and scalability.

items.title: Access OpenAI models and Codex through your Oracle cloud commitment

items.why_it_matters: Tech leads can now utilize AI models more efficiently within their existing Oracle Cloud infrastructure, simplifying deployment and governance.
